SELECT 
    f.CDSCode AS School_Code,
    f.`School Name` AS School_Name,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS Is_Charter_School,
    f.`Low Grade` || '-' || f.`High Grade` AS Grades_Served,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath < 1200 THEN 'Below Average'
        WHEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath >= 1200 AND s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath <= 1500 THEN 'Average'
        WHEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath > 1500 THEN 'Above Average'
        ELSE 'No SAT Data'
    END AS SAT_Performance_Level,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS School_Free_Meal_Rate,
    ROUND(AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) OVER (), 2) AS County_Average_Free_Meal_Rate,
    ROUND(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` - AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) OVER (), 2) AS Deviation_From_County_Average
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE LOWER(f.`County Name`) = 'alameda'
GROUP BY f.CDSCode, f.`School Name`, f.`Charter School (Y/N)`, f.`Low Grade`, f.`High Grade`, s.AvgScrRead, s.AvgScrMath, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`
ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

    SELECT 
        CDSCode,
        `School Name`,
        `District Name`,
        `Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS EligibleFreeRate
    FROM frpm
    WHERE `School Type` LIKE '%continuation%'
      AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
)
ORDER BY EligibleFreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;

    s.School AS "School Name",
    s.City AS "City",
    s.State AS "State",
    s.OpenDate AS "Open Date",
    s.ClosedDate AS "Closed Date",

    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS "Enrollment (K-12)",
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS "Free Meal % (K-12)",

    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS frpm_percent_k12,

        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 30 AND s.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0) * 100 < 10 THEN 'Low-performing despite low FRPM'

SELECT schools.Phone
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(schools.StatusType) LIKE '%charter%'
AND schools.Charter = 1
AND schools.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS TotalEnrollment,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS PovertyLevel,
    AVG(sat.AvgScrMath) AS AvgSATMathScore,
    SUM(sat.NumTstTakr) AS TotalTestTakers,
    AVG(sat.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadScore,
    AVG(sat.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWriteScore

    s.CDSCode, s.School, s.City, s.State, f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`

SELECT 
    s.cds AS CDSCode,
    s.school AS SchoolName,
    f.`School Name` AS FRPM_SchoolName,
    s.magnet AS IsMagnet,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` >= 50 THEN 'High Poverty'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` >= 30 AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` < 50 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
        ELSE 'Low Poverty'
    END AS PovertyLevel,
    s.enroll12 AS Enrollment,
    s.numtsttakr AS NumTstTakr,
    s.avgscrread AS AvgScrRead,
    s.avgscrmath AS AvgScrMath,
    s.avgscrwrite AS AvgScrWrite,
    (s.avgscrread + s.avgscrmath + s.avgscrwrite) AS TotalAvgSATScore
FROM satscores s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.magnet = 1 
    AND s.numtsttakr > 500
ORDER BY TotalAvgSATScore DESC;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.School,
    s.District,
    s.County,
    f.`School Name` AS SchoolName,
    f.`District Name` AS DistrictName,
    f.`School Type` AS SchoolType,
    f.`District Type` AS DistrictType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K12,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS FreeMealCount_K12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS PercentEligibleFree_K12,
    f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS FRPMCount_K12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS PercentEligibleFRPM_K12,
    sc.AvgScrRead,
    sc.AvgScrMath,
    sc.AvgScrWrite,
    sc.NumTstTakr
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sc ON LOWER(f.CDSCode) = LOWER(sc.cds)
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM frpm f JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 560 AND f.`Charter Funding Type` IS NOT NULL;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode AS "School Code",
    s.School AS "School Name",
    s.City AS "City",
    s.State AS "State",
    s.County AS "County",
    s.District AS "District",
    s.Charter AS "Charter Status",
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS "Enrollment",
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS "Free Meal %",
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS "FRPM %",
    sc.AvgScrRead AS "Avg Reading Score",
    sc.AvgScrMath AS "Avg Math Score",
    sc.AvgScrWrite AS "Avg Writing Score",
    sc.NumTstTakr AS "Num Test Takers"

JOIN frpm f ON sc.cds = f.CDSCode
JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode

SELECT 
    f.`County Name` AS County,
    f.`School Name`,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` >= 75 THEN 'High'
        WHEN f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` BETWEEN 50 AND 74 THEN 'Medium'
        ELSE 'Low'
    END AS FRPM_Category,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Total_Enrollment,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)`,
    s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite AS Total_SAT_Score,
    s.NumGE1500 AS Num_GE_1500
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` + f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 500
    AND (LOWER(f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) LIKE '%60%' OR LOWER(s.NumGE1500) >= 30)
ORDER BY f.`County Name`, Total_Enrollment DESC, FRPM_Category;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    s.County,
    s.District,
    s.StatusType,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS Enrollment_K_12,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS Free_Meal_Count_K_12,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS Percent_Eligible_Free_K_12,
    f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS Enrollment_Ages_5_17,
    f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` AS Free_Meal_Count_Ages_5_17,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS Percent_Eligible_Free_Ages_5_17,
    s.NumTstTakr,
    s.NumGE1500,
    CASE 
        WHEN s.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS SAT_Excellence_Rate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.StatusType) = 'active'
    AND (CASE 
            WHEN s.NumTstTakr > 0 THEN CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr 
            ELSE 0 
         END) > 0.30
ORDER BY f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` DESC, f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT TOP 3 schools.School, schools.Phone, schools.City, schools.Charter, frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS PovertyRate
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE satscores.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY (satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT CDSCode AS NCES_school_identification_number, `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS enrollment_count
FROM frpm
ORDER BY `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT dname AS District, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores
WHERE rtype = 'District'
GROUP BY dname
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM satscores WHERE LOWER(cname) LIKE '%merged alameda%' AND NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT s.CDSCode AS school_code, s.CharterNum AS charter_number, AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write_score
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND sa.rtype = 'K-12'
GROUP BY s.CDSCode, s.CharterNum
ORDER BY avg_write_score DESC;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN NumTstTakr < 50 THEN 'Under 50 Testers'
        WHEN NumTstTakr BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN '50-100 Testers'
        WHEN NumTstTakr BETWEEN 101 AND 250 THEN '100-250 Testers'
        ELSE 'Other'
    END AS TestingVolumeCategory,
    AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore,
    AVG(AvgScrMath) AS AvgMathScore,
    AVG(AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore,
    COUNT(*) AS SchoolCount,
    SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS TotalEnrollment,
    SUM(`Free Meal Count (K-12)`) AS TotalFreeMeals,
    AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`) AS AvgFreeMealPercentage,
    SUM(`FRPM Count (K-12)`) AS TotalFRPMCount,
    AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS AvgFRPMPercentage
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(schools.FundingType) = 'directly funded'
    AND LOWER(schools.CharterNum) LIKE '%charter%'
    AND LOWER(schools.County) = 'fresno'
    AND NumTstTakr <= 250
GROUP BY TestingVolumeCategory;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS school_name,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.Phone,
    s.Website,
    f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_status,
    s.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS enrollment,
    s.AvgScrMath AS avg_math_score,
    s.AvgScrRead AS avg_read_score,
    s.AvgScrWrite AS avg_write_score,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS percent_eligible_free_meals,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS percent_eligible_frpm
FROM 
    schools s
JOIN 
    frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN 
    satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE 
    s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND sat.NumTstTakr >= 10
ORDER BY 
    sat.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS total_schools,
    AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS average_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN `Enrollment (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS charter_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN `Enrollment (K-12)` ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_enrollment,
    AVG(`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`) AS average_poverty_rate,
    COUNT(DISTINCT `District Code`) AS number_of_districts,
    MAX(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS largest_school_enrollment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > 0.75 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_poverty_schools_count
FROM frpm
WHERE LOWER(`County Name`) = 'amador'
    AND (`Low Grade` = '9' OR `High Grade` = '12')
    AND (`Low Grade` = '9' OR `High Grade` = '12');

SELECT 
    ROUND(AVG(f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)`)) AS avg_free_meal_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS charter_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_charter_count,
    ROUND(AVG(s.AvgScrRead)) AS avg_sat_read_score,
    ROUND(AVG(s.AvgScrMath)) AS avg_sat_math_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS very_high_category_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` <= 600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_category_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` <= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS moderate_category_count
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE LOWER(f.`County Name`) LIKE '%los angeles%'
    AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
    AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700;

SELECT `School Name` AS School, NumTstTakr AS Test_Takers
FROM satscores
JOIN frpm ON satscores.cds = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(`County Name`) LIKE '%contra costa%'
ORDER BY NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    f.`School Name`,
    s.Street,
    s.City,
    s.Zip,
    (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS EnrollmentDifference
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE ABS(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30;

SELECT 
    f.`School Name` AS school_name,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` AS percent_eligible_free_k12,
    s.NumTstTakr AS test_takers
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)` > 0.1
    AND s.NumTstTakr >= 1500;

SELECT `School Name` AS SchoolName, `Educational Option Type` AS EducationalOptionType
FROM frpm
WHERE LOWER(`County Name`) LIKE '%riverside%'
  AND (
    SELECT AVG(AvgScrMath)
    FROM satscores
    WHERE cds = frpm.CDSCode
  ) > 400;

SELECT 
    s.School AS school_name,
    COALESCE(s.Street || ', ' || s.City || ', ' || s.State || ' ' || s.Zip, '') AS full_address
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.School) LIKE '%high%'
    AND LOWER(s.City) LIKE '%monterey%'
    AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800;

SELECT 
    s.School AS SchoolName,
    AVG(sa.AvgScrWrite) AS AvgWritingScore,
    s.Phone AS PhoneNumber
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE (s.OpenDate IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', s.OpenDate) > 1991)
   AND (s.ClosedDate IS NULL OR strftime('%Y', s.ClosedDate) < 2000)
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone;

SELECT 
    `School Name`,
    DOCType,
    (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS enrollment_diff
FROM frpm
WHERE LOWER(`Funding Type`) = 'locally funded'
AND (`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (
    SELECT AVG(`Enrollment (K-12)` - `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`)
    FROM frpm
    WHERE LOWER(`Funding Type`) = 'locally funded'
);

SELECT MIN(s.OpenDate) AS OpenDate
FROM frpm f
JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
  AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0;

SELECT City, SUM(`Enrollment (K-12)`) AS Total_Enrollment
FROM frpm
WHERE `Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY City
ORDER BY Total_Enrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT 
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School AS School_Name,
    s.City,
    s.State,
    s.County,
    f.`School Type` AS School_Type,
    f.`Low Grade`,
    f.`High Grade`,
    f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS K12_Enrollment,
    f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS Free_Meal_Count_K12,
    CASE 
        WHEN f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0 THEN ROUND(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 4)
        ELSE NULL 
    END AS Free_Meal_Eligibility_Rate_K12,
    sat.AvgScrRead AS Avg_Score_Read,
    sat.AvgScrMath AS Avg_Score_Math,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS Avg_Score_Write,
    sat.NumTstTakr AS Num_Tests_Taken
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE s.CDSCode IN (
    SELECT CDSCode 
    FROM frpm 
    ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC 
    LIMIT 2 OFFSET 8
)
ORDER BY K12_Enrollment DESC;

SELECT 
    s.cds AS school_id,
    s.sname AS school_name,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` AS frpm_rate,
    AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS avg_read_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score,
    AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_write_score,
    SUM(s.NumGE1500) AS high_scorers_1500_plus,
    SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(s.NumTstTakr) > 0 THEN CAST(SUM(s.NumGE1500) AS REAL) / SUM(s.NumTstTakr) * 100
        ELSE 0 
    END AS high_scorer_rate_pct
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE LOWER(s.soc) = LOWER('66')
GROUP BY s.cds, s.sname, f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
ORDER BY CAST(f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(f.`Enrollment (K-12)` AS REAL), 0) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `School Name` AS SchoolName, Website 
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT s.AdmEmail1 AS administrator_email
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.Charter = 1
ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.AdmFName1 AS First_Name,
    s.AdmLName1 AS Last_Name
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sc ON s.CDSCode = sc.cds
WHERE sc.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY (sc.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / sc.NumTstTakr) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(s.City) LIKE '%los angeles%'
  AND LOWER(s.County) = 'los angeles'
  AND f.`NumTstTakr` BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(satscores.NumTstTakr) AS average_test_takers
FROM satscores
JOIN schools ON satscores.cds = schools.CDSCode
WHERE LOWER(schools.County) LIKE '%fresno%'
  AND schools.OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
  AND schools.OpenDate <= '1980-12-31';

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE LOWER(s.District) LIKE '%fresno unified%'
ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT School, AVG(AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores
WHERE rtype = 'V'
GROUP BY cds
HAVING AVG(AvgScrRead) >= (
    SELECT AVG(AvgScrRead)
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'V'
    AND County = satscores.County
)
ORDER BY AVG(AvgScrRead) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT `Educational Option Type` AS education_type
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.AvgScrMath) AS avg_math_score, s.cname AS county
FROM satscores s
WHERE s.cds IN (
    SELECT cds
    FROM satscores
    ORDER BY (AvgScrRead + AvgScrMath + AvgScrWrite) / 3.0
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT AVG(s.AvgScrWrite) AS avg_writing_score, sc.City AS city
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumGE1500 > 0
GROUP BY s.cds
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    s.cds AS School_Code,
    s.School AS School_Name,
    s.District AS District_Name,
    s.County AS County_Name,
